summary: Iteration 2 - full auth/CORS/rate-limit regression. Migrated backend tests to send X-API-Key, added test_auth_and_cors.py (public root, 401 missing key on all protected endpoints, 401 on bad key, per-key acceptance for console/worker-app/partner-app, CORS allowed-vs-disallowed origin preflight) and test_rate_limit.py (temporarily lowered RATE_LIMIT_READ=3, restarted backend, proved 429+Retry-After for one key while a different key still gets 200, then restored RATE_LIMIT_READ=300 and restarted). 30/30 backend pytest cases pass. UI end-to-end still green: header shows 20 cases / 36 facilities (meta call with key works), chest-pain preset -> Emergency result renders, Case logs / Facility directory / API & playground tabs all load without a single 401 in the browser console, playground Send returns 200 payload, and the API tab correctly shows the Authentication card with a masked X-API-Key + Rate limits card + /api/ tagged public.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py Retry-After computation `WINDOW - int(now.timestamp()) % WINDOW` is a reasonable seconds-until-next-window value but slightly off at the exact boundary (returns 60 instead of 0 when timestamp % 60 == 0). Cosmetic.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown; migrate to lifespan handlers.

load_dotenv is called both in auth.py and server.py; harmless but redundant. auth.py reads os.environ['API_KEYS'] at import time - if API_KEYS is missing the module raises KeyError instead of a friendly RuntimeError; consider aligning with the other _parse_keys validation errors.

rate_limits collection uses a compound-ish string key `{digest}:{limit}:{window}`. If TRIAGE_LIMIT and READ_LIMIT ever share the same numeric value, and both a read and write route are hit in the same window with the same key, they will share a counter. Currently 60 vs 300 so fine, but worth documenting.
CSV import still has no dedup on (name+pincode); repeated valid imports will bloat facility count (already flagged in iteration 1).
TriageRequest still has no Field(ge=1, le=10) on severity_reported or age bounds (already flagged).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 tabs + chest-pain preset triage + playground Send, no auth errors)
